modelingNotes: OSM outline controls width, depth and heading; the 18 m total height is retained.
Three vaulted openings and attic proportions follow reviewed daylight views; individual sculptural reliefs are omitted.
Eight freestanding columns and a small abstract four-horse roof group preserve the silhouette with original simple geometry.

assets.licenseScope: CC BY applies to original artistic contributions only; ODbL applies to OSM-derived spatial data. Reference photographs retain their own licenses.
modelingNotes: OSM supplies centre, north alignment and 330 m overall height.
Deck elevations 57, 115 and 276 m and 125 m base width follow the official Eiffel Tower figures: https://www.toureiffel.paris/fr/le-monument/chiffres-cle .
Four curved lattice piers, arch spandrels and taper are original simplified interpretations of the reviewed daylight references.
Structural lattice members are widened for clearer map-scale readability.
Cross sections, railing rhythm, summit equipment and arch profiles are inferred; no nighttime sparkle installation.

modelingNotes: The OSM outline, open court and mapped side wings determine placement. Original geometry is included with the source.

modelingNotes: The hospital footprint is combined with adjoining cathedral way/64955027 and dome church way/112452790 from the saved OSM site extract; additional source IDs are preserved.
Mapped part heights and courtyard voids are retained, including the 100 m lantern in this snapshot. No survey accuracy is implied.
Roof slopes are simplified setback profiles; the dome retains its mapped curved profile and a muted warm metal material.
Window rhythm, cornices and simplified golden accents follow reviewed aerial and exterior photos. Sculpture is omitted.

modelingNotes: The saved palace outline, six courtyard voids and mapped pavilion plans control this model; the separate glass Pyramid is outside this palace asset.
OSM lacks part heights here. Main eaves 22 m, roof rise 5 m and terminal pavilion heights 38 m are inferred from the reviewed exterior references.
Outline simplification is 1.2 m to remove small facade notches within the map-scale mesh budget; the original source geometry is distributed unchanged.
Mansards are simplified setback slopes. Relief sculpture, individual chimneys and small dormers are omitted.

modelingNotes: Uses the saved 270 OSM parts, their measured heights and the outline with 21 courtyard holes. Sainte-Chapelle is outside this footprint and remains a separate model.
Small low parts below 35 square metres are omitted; named and tall tower parts retain their plans. Outline simplification is 0.35 m.

Facade openings and bands are inferred from the reviewed entrance photograph; sculpture and interior rooms are omitted.
